jobs.title: Pediatric Hematology Oncology Advanced Practice Provider
Advanced Practice Provider (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) for Primary Care
NP/PA Pediatric/Newborn Hospitalist Opportunity in Greenville/Morehead City, NC

notes: Carolinas gap group: 14 of 16 hospitals checked, 2 unreachable (Granville and Washington Regional sites block fetchers and searches found no employer postings). 9 jobs: 5 relevance-3 (Pediatrix NNP at CaroMont Gastonia, two ECU Health pediatric/newborn hospitalist NP/PA roles at Carteret, Mission NNP and newborn APP), 1 relevance-2 (Mission peds heme/onc APP), 3 relevance-1 hotspot generic NP/PA roles. Fetch tool returned paraphrased rather than verbatim descriptions for most postings. HCA SC hospitals (Summerville, Trident, Grand Strand, Colleton) were covered only by domain-restricted searches of careers.hcahealthcare.com, which surfaced no NP pediatric roles (only a Colleton pediatric hospitalist physician and a Pediatrix PICU intensivist physician at Grand Strand). 36 of 40 web calls used.

url_fixes.why: Iredell careers page links to Paylocity (company 1321); the list page is JS-rendered so the engine needs a browser/paylocity adapter. Posting detail pages look like recruiting.paylocity.com/Recruiting/Jobs/Details/<id>.

CaroMont careers page links to a HealthcareSource Position Manager board (JS-rendered). Provider category filter: Job Category=Physician/Non-Physician Providers. NICU NNP roles are posted by Pediatrix on clinical-pediatrix.icims.com instead.
Same CaroMont HealthcareSource board as Gastonia.
Conway careers page links to a HealthcareSource Position Manager board (JS-rendered).

/careers/ is 404; the site uses getpage.php. Employment page is getpage.php?name=employment&sub=Careers and provider (physician/PA/NP) openings are listed as plain text on the physician_opportunities page.
Careers landing page links to an on-site career search page; APP category page is /careers/career-areas/advanced-practice-providers.
The bmhsc.org career-search page embeds an AppOne (Paycor) applicant board; that is the real listing source.
